topic: I found cavities between my teeth and i've already had my yearly checkup. Can this wait or should I book an earlier appointment?
human_review: BLOQUEAR (model only, confirm or dismiss) fact_vs_ficha: 'If you have facial swelling along with a fever, or trouble breathing or swallowing, go to an emergen': The ficha says swelling that spreads to the face or neck is an emergency, but the post sends facial swelling to an ER only when a fever is also present, which could delay care for a spreading dental infection.
